question: Which data components does the detection analytic AN0280 draw on?

authored_steps.sub_question: Which data components does the detection analytic AN0280 draw on?
authored_steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:MONITORS]->(m0) WHERE n:Analytic OR NOT (n:Analytic OR n:DataComponent) WITH n, collect(DISTINCT {m: m0, r: 'MONITORS'}) AS h0 OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[:MONITORS]-(m1) WHERE n:DataComponent OR NOT (n:Analytic OR n:DataComponent) WITH n, h0, collect(DISTINCT {m: m1, r: 'MONITORS'}) AS h1 WITH n, h0 + h1 AS hops UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(hops) = 0 THEN [{m: null, r: null}] ELSE hops END) AS hop RETURN coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) AS anchor_id, n.name AS anchor_name, labels(n)[0] AS anchor_label, coalesce(hop.m.attack_id, hop.m.id) AS neighbour_id, hop.m.name AS neighbour_name, labels(hop.m)[0] AS neighbour_label, hop.r AS rel_typ

planner_observed_plan.text: Retrieve all DataComponent nodes that are MONITORS targets of the Analytic identified as AN0280.

planner_executed_steps.sub_question: Retrieve all DataComponent nodes that are MONITORS targets of the Analytic identified as AN0280.
planner_executed_steps.query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(term IN $names WHERE toLower(n.name) CONTAINS term) WITH collect(n) AS cand WITH cand, [x IN cand WHERE any(t IN $names WHERE toLower(x.name) = t)] AS exact UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(exact) > 0 THEN exact ELSE cand END) AS n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:MONITORS]-(m) RETURN coalesce(n.attack_id, n.id) AS anchor_id, n.name AS anchor_name, labels(n)[0] AS anchor_label, coalesce(m.attack_id, m.id) AS neighbour_id, m.name AS neighbour_name, labels(m)[0] AS neighbour_label, type(r) AS rel_type LIMIT 1000
